## Why visit

A strong traditional partner to Hoylake’s modern micropub scene. The two-room layout, local-history decoration and unusual mirrored ceiling give it an individual character, while the beach is close enough to add a short daylight walk. Its inclusion is supported by changing cask and a 2026 branch Pub of Excellence award rather than scenery alone. This is the stop for settling into a neighbourhood pub after sampling at Black Toad, with a winter fire adding to its particularly strong appeal in November.
